title: REST FOR THE
WEARY SOUL
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: midday sun pouring through window on wooden desk
abstract golden light reflection on still water
lonely mountain path under high noon sun
soft breeze moving tall blades of grass
close up of an empty chair in warm light
top down view of a calm garden bench

scenes.a: That relentless pace you have kept since dawn is drawing your strength down to nothing.
Listen to the invitation of your Savior in this hour.
And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while:
for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
Lord, pull me out of the chaos of this day and into your holy, quiet center.
Teach me how to dwell in your stillness while the demands of life continue around me.
